newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge on borrowing pressure.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge on borrowing pressure.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates soared on borrowing pressure after opening lower on Monday and dealer said rates were likely to remain high on Tuesday amid tight liquidity.
The overnight rates opened at 2.50 percent but soon the rates went up to 10 percent due to heavy borrowing demand, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The dealer said market ended short and some banks borrowed about 300 million rupees from the State (central) Bank of Pakistan.
